_comment: The roles who-iris's own processes bind: the lanes of the four IRIS CDN export diagrams (processes/iris-cdn-*.bpmn, who-iris#103). Each inherits the harness role it specialises, so it carries that role's skills too. Schema: cat-harness-tools/schemas/process/role-graph.ts.
name: who-iris

roles.title: IRIS CDN owner
roles.description: A person: decides the export's scope, budget and storage target. Nothing downstream widens what the owner approved.

roles.title: IRIS CDN Exporter
roles.description: The agent role. It plans, reviews and reports; it does not hold the signing key, and it never pushes to a WHO repository.

roles.title: Cloudflare R2 and CDN
roles.description: Object storage behind the CDN. Every object is named by its SHA-256 and served with an immutable cache policy; an object already present is never written again. Also serves did.json. A mechanical role, held to the contract its skills state.

roles.title: Cloudflare git (Artifacts)
roles.description: A git repository hosted on Cloudflare Artifacts, not GitHub. Holds the release history: BagIt tag files, signatures, the cursor, checkpoints and run reports. A mechanical role: written to, deciding nothing.

roles.title: Release signer
roles.description: Holds the P-256 private key (GitHub environment secret IRIS_CDN_SIGNING_JWK) and signs each changed item manifest and the release tag manifest. A mechanical role.

roles.title: IRIS CDN verifier
roles.description: Anyone. Resolves the key from the did:web DID document, never from the package, and checks its x5c chain up to WHO's signing key. Cannot reach it: the verdict is unknown, not verified.
